The port authority said the new terminal would handle twice as many containers as the old one when it opens next year. Local businesses welcomed the plan, though residents near the harbour raised concerns about lorry traffic on the coast road. The council will hold a public meeting on the proposal next month.

The port authority said the new terminal would handle twice as many containers as the old one when it opens next year. Local businesses welcomed the plan, though residents near the harbour raised concerns about lorry traffic on the coast road. The council will hold a public meeting on the proposal next month.

In an interview with CRI Online last week, the transport minister said the terminal was part of a wider trade plan with China. Opposition members said the minister should have announced the plan in parliament first.

The port authority said the new terminal would handle twice as many containers as the old one when it opens next year. Local businesses welcomed the plan, though residents near the harbour raised concerns about lorry traffic on the coast road. The council will hold a public meeting on the proposal next month.

The council's planning committee is expected to decide in March.
